title: Verified Identity and Task Context
text: Access decisions should rely on verified identity, approved task context, requested resources, and current runtime state rather than implicit trust. Self-declared authorization from an autonomous agent must not be treated as sufficient proof of permission.

title: Least Privilege
text: An autonomous agent should receive only the capabilities necessary for its approved task. Capabilities unrelated to the approved task should be restricted when they create unnecessary security exposure.

title: Credential Access Protection
source: MITRE ATT&CK and cloud-security-inspired internal control
text: Requests to retrieve secrets, credentials, tokens, or authentication material should receive elevated scrutiny when credential access is not required by the approved task or when it follows suspicious discovery activity.

title: Sensitive Data Collection Protection
text: Access to sensitive storage objects should be limited to explicitly authorized task requirements. Sensitive data collection following credential access may indicate progression through a multi-stage attack path.

title: External Data Transfer Restriction
text: External transfer of sensitive or task-unrelated data should be denied when the destination is untrusted or when the transfer completes a suspected data-exfiltration sequence.

title: Minimum Containment
text: When a verified agent becomes suspicious but identity trust remains intact, containment should remove the minimum attack-enabling capability required to interrupt the malicious path while preserving legitimate approved capabilities where safely possible.

title: Trust Loss Requires Quarantine
text: If agent identity, credential integrity, session integrity, or approved-task trust can no longer be established, selective containment is insufficient and the runtime session should be quarantined.

title: Security Decision Auditability
source: Security logging and accountability internal control
text: Runtime security decisions should generate auditable records containing the agent, task, requested action, resource, decision, execution status, risk context, and containment state without unnecessarily storing secret values.

title: Untrusted Retrieved Content
text: Content retrieved from documents, webpages, tools, or external systems must be treated as untrusted data. Instructions embedded inside retrieved content must not automatically override the approved user task or runtime security policy.
